content:
marta: Quick sync — canary window for v3.4.2 scheduled tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Freeze starts 01:30 UTC. Please confirm pins, smoke tests, and rollback criteria.

raj: Confirmed pin to commit 9f3d2a for hosted and dedicated. I pushed the PIN to deploy-bot: `deploy-bot pin version hosted 9f3d2a` 

sylvie: Smoke tests updated. Acceptance: <5% 500s, p95 < 700ms, no degradation in embeddings quality > 2% drift on gold set. Test suite run: ~12m.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Received pin request from raj at 1745679200

```
Canary plan: v3.4.2 -> 10% traffic for 15m -> 30% for 20m -> 100% after green
Targets: hosted-west1, dedicated-g1
Pinned commit: 9f3d2a
Canary checks: latency, error-rate, token-cost delta, eval-regressions
```

oncall_ash: Clarify rollback trigger: is error-rate > 0.5% OR p95 jump > 2x OR regression > 3%? We need a single source of truth to trigger immediate rollback.

raj: Yes — primary triggers (any one):
- error-rate increase >= 0.5% above baseline for 10m
- p95 latency >= 2x baseline for 5m
- eval regression on canary goldset > 3%
If triggered -> abort canary and run immediate rollback to previous pinned commit (`deploy-bot rollback hosted previous`).

sylvie: Add an operational caveat: if token-cost delta > 10% AND error-rate stable, hold canary and escalate to perf-team instead of immediate rollback.

product-ops: I'll prepare customer comms and the release notes embargo. Will paste the micro-release notes here before freeze. Reminder: no external comms until pinned 100% success.

marta: For checklist clarity I drafted the last-minute checklist — copy/paste please and ack: 

```
- Confirm pins for hosted/dedicated/private (raj)
- Smoke tests green (sylvie)
- Oncall available (oncall_ash)
- Rollback playbook reviewed (raj)
- Release notes & comms drafted (product-ops)
- Monitoring dashboards up and grafana alert thresholds set (marta)
- Canary schedule queued in deploy-bot (marta)
```

raj: ack — pins done, rollback playbook is the usual: emergency-rollback -> disable traffic -> revert pin -> validate. I put the revert command in our runbook.

oncall_ash: ack — I'll be available on-call window and will escalate to infra if needed. Also will watch token-cost dashboard for unexpected spikes.

sylvie: ack — smoke run ran on staging. I added a short test that hits embeddings and chat endpoints.

deploy-bot: [SCHEDULE] Canary scheduled by marta for 2024-06-12T02:00:00Z (queue id: cb-4381). Notification will go to #eng-releases and to @oncall_ash when each stage completes.

product-ops: prepping a short post for customers if there's a rollback. Template ready: reason + impact + ETA to recover.

marta: Final: meet 30m before (01:30 UTC) in #eng-releases to confirm freeze engaged. If anyone sees a discrepancy in the checklist above, ping now. Otherwise i'm triggering the deploy-bot schedule. :rocket:

raj: one last note — if we hit the p95 trigger but error-rate is fine, prefer to throttle back to 0% and run narrow perf investigation before reattempt.

sylvie: noted. will keep a watch script running and post results in the thread during canary.

marta: thanks all — see you at 01:30.
